content.comment_body: Hello. I created a small program for my [product_name] using [product_name] Demo. I didn’t have a [product_name] cable, so I manually entered the program. I noticed the “Message texts” box looks different in the PC program and on the [product_name] device. In the PC program, I can get the message box to show date and time, but not on the actual device. Am I missing something, or is showing date and time in the “Message texts” box only possible when programming with [product_name] software? Best regards, [user_name].

Dear [user_name], I've never programmed [product_name] directly from its menu and this is the first time I’ve heard of someone doing so. I know some manufacturers let you program their controllers with just a few keys and a small monochrome display, but I rarely hear about people actually using this. I hope your program isn’t too complex! You have my respect. Regarding your issue, since I'm not familiar with programming [product_name] without [product_name] software, I can't confirm if there are differences between blocks in software and on the device memory. However, if you want to display date and time while your program runs, you can set a start screen with date and time. There are detailed instructions in this manual: [url] — look at chapter 5, especially 5.1 and 5.2.3. Hope this helps. Regards, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], it’s possible. When you look at the "message text" function block on the display, it has three connection inputs: EN, P, Par. If you go to "Par", you can select date and time.

Thanks to both of you (and thanks for the respect). Don’t worry, my programs aren’t too complex. I did try "Par" but couldn’t find date and time on the display. In the [product_name] software, you can set date and time to appear in the “Message box”, but I can’t find that feature when using the display directly. I could remove the “Message box”, but I connected LED spots and want to show their total on-time; it's not essential, but I’m curious why I can’t get this to work on the device when it works in the simulation. Best regards, [user_name]

Which type of device do you have (please provide the [article_no])? Message text can be used in [product_name] since [article_no]. For current date and time in this function, you need [product_name] [article_no] or newer. When using the demo software (probably [product_name] V5), the hardware usually defaults to [article_no], where all features are available. To see what functions are possible, select your device under “Tools->Select Hardware”. Hope this helps. Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], thanks for the info. My device is [article_no], so that explains the issue. Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users observe differences in feature support between [product_name] software on PC and the actual [product_name] hardware, especially regarding the ability to display date and time in the 'Message texts' box. The inconsistent features across hardware versions create confusion about device capabilities and highlight users’ desire for software and hardware consistency.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the date and time display available in the [product_name] software simulation to also be present in their physical [product_name] device. They assume function blocks will behave identically in software and hardware.
